transcript: My name is Nithung Silva and I am finally at undergraduate preparing for UI UX designer role. I have practiced Figma via frame and usability testing through academic work and small projects. One project I work on was sales analyst, kits, dashboard and small business operation domain. My main contribution was sales chart and monthly reporting. The main issue was missing value and in sales record. So I checked the problem and discussed it with my team. At the end, the system made reporting easier and easier for business discussion making. I am applying for this job because I want real industry expose and a chance to improve my technical skills. My strength is on a ship of tasks but I still need improve my answering under pressure.
feedback: Nithung, your answer shows a good understanding of the UI UX designer role and your experience with Figma and usability testing is a plus. However, there were moments where your explanation felt a bit rushed and lacked specific details about your design process and the impact of your contributions.
suggestions: Practice explaining your design decisions and process in a structured manner
Use simple, professional language to describe complex technical concepts
Prepare examples that demonstrate your problem-solving skills in UI UX design
Take a moment to collect your thoughts before answering to ensure clarity and confidence
better_answer_example: In my recent project as a sales analyst, I utilized Figma to create interactive dashboards and conducted usability testing to identify areas for improvement. One challenge I faced was addressing missing values in sales records, which I overcame by collaborating with my team and implementing a more efficient reporting system. This experience not only honed my technical skills in UI UX design but also taught me the importance of effective communication in a team setting, which I believe is crucial for success in this role.
